Phenotype: Indicates type of activity observed: activator, inactive, or inconclusive.
Potency: Concentration at which compound exhibits half-maximal efficacy, AC50. Extrapolated AC50s also include the highest efficacy observed and the concentration of compound at which it was observed.
Efficacy: Maximal efficacy of compound, reported as a percentage of control. These values are estimated based on fits of the Hill equation to the dose-response curves.
Analysis Comment: Annotation/notes on a particular compound's data or its analysis.
Curve Description: A description of dose-response curve quality. A complete curve has two observed asymptotes; a partial curve may not have attained its second asymptote at the highest concentration tested. High efficacy curves exhibit efficacy greater than 80% of control. Partial efficacies are statistically signficant, but below 80% of control.
Fit_LogAC50: The logarithm of the AC50 from a fit of the ratio data to the Hill equation.
Fit_HillSlope: The Hill slope from a fit of the ratio data to the Hill equation.
Fit_R2: R^2 fit value of ratio curve. Closer to 1.0 equates to better Hill equation fit.
Fit_InfiniteActivity: The asymptotic efficacy from a fit of the ratio data to the Hill equation.
Fit_ZeroActivity: Efficacy at zero concentration of compound from a fit of the ratio data to the Hill equation.
Fit_CurveClass: Numerical encoding of curve description for the fitted Hill equation.
ExcludedPoints: Which dose-response titration points were excluded from analysis based on outlier analysis. Each number represents whether a titration point was (1) or was not (0) excluded, for the titration series going from smallest to highest compound concentrations.
Compound Type: NCGC designation for compound stage: 'qHTS Exploratory', 'NIHSMR', 'Compound Followup', 'Compound Verification', 'Probe Optimization'
Compound QC: NCGC designation for data stage: 'qHTS', 'qHTS Verification', 'Secondary Profiling'
